old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-vdon","title":"Native address routing and identity specs contradict canonical 0200::/8 SHA-512 derivation","description":"Final correctness review found incompatible definitions of the key-derived native address space and IID algorithm. Canonical Python yggdrasil_address() fixes addr[0]=0x02 and derives the IID from SHA-512; SCHC Rules 1/6, spec/03-adaptation.md, the SCHC draft, generators, and vectors therefore match only 0200::/8. But python/src/lichen/node.py configures Router with IPv6Network('0200::/7'), python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py::_is_global admits first bytes 0x02 and 0x03, and spec/01-architecture.md, 04-network.md, 05-routing.md, 06-security.md plus vector descriptions call the space 0200::/7 or 02xx::/7. Consequently the router can classify 0300::/8 destinations as native mesh even though no canonical key derivation creates them and SCHC Rules 1/6 reject them. In addition, spec/04-network.md section 6.2 shows IID=SHA-256(pubkey)[0:8], contradicting its own references, spec/06-security, Python, and exact vectors that require SHA-512. Establish the canonical 0200::/8 + SHA-512 definition everywhere, narrow routing/global classification accordingly, update stale vector prose, and add negative coverage proving 03xx addresses are not native-profile addresses.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:56:11.759887Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:56:11.759887Z"}

new_value: {"notes":"Decision: Full Yggdrasil compat. Implement exact AddrForKey algorithm from yggdrasil-go: invert pubkey, count leading 1s, embed in address per upstream spec. This is a BREAKING CHANGE - all existing addresses will change. Address space becomes 0200::/7 (not /8). SHA-512 hash approach is abandoned.\n2026-09-08 OVERRIDING ADJUDICATION: Mark reaffirmed upstream Yggdrasil addressing EVERYWHERE. See upstream-yggdrasil-addressing in spec/decisions.jsonl and Settled Protocol Decisions in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. This supersedes conflicting descriptions/notes/closures that bless SHA-512 native addressing, require preserving its bytes or IID-equality invariant, or call for blanket /8-to-/7 replacement. Node /128 MUST equal upstream AddrForKey(key) in 0200::/8. Routed /64, when used, MUST equal upstream SubnetForKey(key) in 0300::/8; 0200::/7 is the aggregate only. Standard link-local/multicast control retains scope. Follow exact pinned upstream source, not the abbreviated algorithm in old issues. Conformance oracle is independently obtained byte-equality vectors from yggdrasil-go revision 422836eeb21a99790caa286aa63d493bbc4766d7 (address.go/address_test.go), not agreement among LICHEN implementations. Report conflicting old tests/fixtures; do not weaken tests or generate expected results from code under test. Classify node versus subnet traffic correctly in routing/SCHC without altering upstream identities. Breaking address changes were already accepted in worker6-vdon. Existing migration work is incomplete; this annotation does not claim it is fixed. Scope origin: project-LICHEN-worker6-rmjn."}
